name: Radiance Technologies
old_description: Our employee-owners can be trusted and they trust their teammates to do the “right thing”
about:
Founded in 1999 in Huntsville, Alabama, by George Clark, John Dennis, and Scott Dublin, Radiance Technologies began as an employee-owned subcontractor supporting the U.S. Army Space and Missile Defense Command. The company later relocated its corporate headquarters to Ruston, Louisiana.

Radiance delivers intelligence analysis, cyber operations, directed energy systems, hypersonics, space solutions, and AI/ML applications for defense and intelligence customers. Its capabilities span systems engineering, modeling and simulation, software development, prototyping, low-rate manufacturing, and hardware-in-the-loop testing. The firm operates facilities in nine states and project offices in fourteen states, employing over 500 people as of 2015 with revenue of $116.7 million that year.

Primary customers include the U.S. Department of Defense, the Intelligence Community, the U.S. Army (SMDC, INSCOM), NASA, and commercial aerospace firms. The company has supported Army hypersonic missile programs, high-energy laser development, and space-based communication and ISR missions.

The founders structured Radiance as an employee-owned enterprise to align incentives with mission success, emphasizing a culture that tackles problems others deem impossible. Leadership states that this ownership model keeps the focus on delivering game-changing solutions rather than maximizing short-term profit.
